correctness.rationale: Properness makes each hub's color list injective and prohibits agreement within a column. Every repeated color therefore has a unique a-side and b-side position in distinct columns. Two repetitions sharing a column must enter and leave it; when their other endpoints agree they give a bichromatic 4-cycle, and with distinct endpoints they give a simple bichromatic four-edge path. Conversely any bichromatic 4-cycle or simple four-edge path has these coincidences, because it alternates and its internal column sits between the two hubs. Thus the repeated classes are precisely directed pairs on disjoint columns. Choosing a k-set of sources, a disjoint k-set of targets and a bijection gives n!/(k!(n-2k)!) partitions, each with 2n-k classes. Assigning injective palette names gives (q)_(2n-k); orientations give weight 2z^3 on labelled pairs and z^2 on singleton columns, hence the stated EGF. The positive-support consecutive ratio (n-2k)(n-2k-1)/(k+1) strictly decreases, proving the log-concavity claim. The formula includes n=1 (one partition with two classes), q below the minimum gives zero, and a palette of the minimum size gives exactly r_*! namings per optimal partition. Inspected the recorded distributions and checker as text; did not execute the supplied script. The evidence for all n is the combinatorial argument, not the finite checks.

originality.rationale: The precise printed polynomial was not located, and the scalar minimum alone would not imply it. But the proof of Casselgren–Granholm–Raspaud Proposition 2.1 explicitly uses the exact obstructing local event: a degree-two column whose two colors are common to the two hubs forces a bichromatic four-edge path or cycle. The implication has no dependence on the number of common colors. The converse is immediate by reading the middle column of such an alternating path or either column of the cycle. The full partition count is then just selecting two disjoint sets of k columns and bijecting them. Thus the proposed central matching classification and coefficient formula are a routine corollary of the known obstruction, rather than new structure inferred merely from the known minimum.
residual_risks: The catalogue search is bounded; no assertion is made that the polynomial has never been printed, nor about catalogue priority. The decision is supported by the actual prior proof, not by the absence of a table.
